newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Canada suspends WTO case on Brazil plane support.
newsitem.headline: Canada suspends WTO case on Brazil plane support.

text.p: Canada on Wednesday suspended a request to the World Trade Organisation to set up a panel to look into export subsidies granted by Brazil to foreign purchasers of light aircraft.
A Canadian official told reporters the decision had been taken to allow more time for consultations between the two countries aimed at getting a bilateral resolution of the dispute.

The WTO's Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) had been due, under its automatic procedure, to agree on Wednesday to establish a panel to rule whether the subsidies were in violation of the global open trading rules.
The official indicated that Ottawa -- which argues the subsidies give Brazilian planes an unfair advantage over similar Canadian aircraft -- hoped that a solution could be found.
The panel request would be renewed later, however, if talks were blocked, the official added.
